summary: Sentient Brands Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a confidential Settlement and Voluntary Share-Surrender Agreement with a former securityholder and affiliated entities. Under the agreement, the Surrendering Entities surrendered 598,200 post-reverse-split restricted shares (about 17,946,000 pre-split) for cancellation without payment, plus all other beneficially owned shares. A related Membership Instrument cancels the Settling Individual's entire interest in a note-holder affiliate, without discharging the Company's debt. Closing is subject to transfer-agent confirmation and customary conditions. Watch for completion of share cancellation and potential reduction in outstanding share count.
